title.zh: 第一轮：Opus 5.5 对 GPT-6 Astra（精简题库）
title.en: Round 1: Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Astra (lite set)

headline.zh: 判对错两家全满分，差距在复刻页面动起来像不像（前端 92.5 对 77.2）和代码质量；GPT-6 Astra 8 道题用 1 小时 19 分、23 美元，Opus 5.5 用 3 小时 6 分、52 美元。
headline.en: Both pass every pass/fail check. The gap is in how the rebuilt screens move (frontend 92.5 vs 77.2) and in code quality, while GPT-6 Astra finishes the 8 tasks in 1 h 19 min for $23 against 3 h 6 min and $52.
